messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3

2.4.5.3. Tests In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, the manufacturer shall, for each type of machinery or related product concerned, perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed.

response.text:
manufacturer | shallPerformOrArrangeTests | appropriate tests verifying compliance with sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2 | for each type of machinery or related product concerned | the manufacturer shall, for each type of machinery or related product concerned, perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed
relevant parts of machinery or related product | mustComplyWith | requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2 | verified by the tests required under this section | In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2
